content.short: The first domain based project on Cardano!
content.description: We want to build the first solution to owning your custom .ada blockchain domain as a native NFT on Cardano. This will introduce the possibility of sending payments directly to your domain instead of your wallet address. You will also be able to store customizable data on the blockchain to be displayed by a regular browser via your personal domain. Inspired by decentralized naming projects on other blockchains we want to bring you a better and cheaper solution by utilizing native tokens on Cardano.
content.meta: Find out about AdaDomains.io (AdaDomains) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
